content.title: Amkor Technology (AMKR): Margin Decline Challenges Bullish Growth Narrative Despite Strong Earnings Forecast
content.summary: Amkor Technology (AMKR) posted earnings that are forecast to grow 22.2% annually, outpacing the broader US market’s 15.6% expected rate. Revenue is projected to rise 7.6% per year, although this trails the US average of 10.1%. Net profit margins have dipped to 4.8% from 5.7% last year, and the company’s earnings have contracted at an 8.1% annual rate over the past five years, reflecting ongoing profitability pressures despite improved growth outlooks ahead. content.title: AMKR Q3 Deep Dive: Advanced Packaging Drives Growth Amid Margin Pressures and CEO Transition
content.summary: Semiconductor packaging and testing company Amkor Technology (NASDAQ:AMKR) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 6.7% year on year to $1.99 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $1.83 billion was less impressive, coming in 1.2% below analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $0.51 per share was 20.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
